data.name: Alaamoon
data.gender_notes: Alaamoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is widely known, renowned for knowledge and wisdom. The name Alaamoon carries the meaning “Highly knowledgeable, wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Alaamoon usually hope their child will grow to embody highly knowledgeable, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of knowledge and wisdom bestowed by God
data.etymology: Alaamoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Highly knowledgeable, wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alaamoon total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عالمون
in_arabic.meaning: العالمون تعني العالمين جميعا أو جميع الخلق
in_arabic.long_meaning: العالمون هو جمع عالم و هو اسم جمع يدل على كثرة العوالم أو سائر العوالم، و قد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفاتحة 'رب العالمين'، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معنى الشمول و العموم، و يدل على عظمة الخالق و كثرة خلقه

in_urdu.name: عالمون
in_urdu.meaning: عالمون کا مطلب ہے تمام دنیا یا تمام مخلوق
in_urdu.long_meaning: عالمون عربی زبان کا ایک جمع اسم ہے جو 'عالم' کی جمع ہے، اور یہ سورة فاتحة میں 'رب العالمين' کے طور پر ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ یہ نام تمام مخلوقات کے رب کی عظمت اور بہتات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا بڑا دینی اور ثقافتی اہمیت ہے

in_hindi.name: आलमून
in_hindi.meaning: आलमून का अर्थ है सारी दुनिया या सभी प्राणी
in_hindi.long_meaning: आलमून एक संज्ञा है जो 'आलम' की बहुलता को दर्शाता है, और यह कुरआन में 'रब्बुल आलमीन' के रूप में उल्लेखित है। यह नाम सारी सृष्टि के रचनहार की महत्ता और बहुलता को प्रकट करता है, और भारतीय मुस्लिम परंपरा में इसकी महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका है

in_pashto.name: عالمون
in_pashto.meaning: عالمون د ټولو نړيو يا ټولو مخلوقاتو معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عالمون د عربی ژبې یو جمعد اسم دی چی د 'عالم' جمع دی، او په سورة فاتحه کې د 'رب العالمين' په توګه ذکر شوی دی. دا نوم د ټولو مخلوقاتو د خالق عظمت او ډیریت ښیي، او په افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې یې لوی مذهبی او کلتوری اهمیت دی

in_english.name: Alaamoon
in_english.meaning: Alaamoon means all worlds or all creations
in_english.long_meaning: Alaamoon is a plural form derived from the Arabic root 'ā-l-m' which signifies world or creation. It is mentioned in the Quran as 'Rabb al-Alamin' (Lord of all worlds). The name embodies the concept of inclusivity and multiplicity, reflecting the vastness and diversity of creation. It holds spiritual significance and cultural importance across Islamic traditions globally

data.cultural_impact: The name Alaamoon carries a sense of recognition, admiration, and respect in the Islamic community. It illustrates a person who has earned a distinguished reputation based on their knowledge and wisdom. Alaamoon is a source of inspiration for many, highlighting the importance of learning and acquiring knowledge in Muslim society. It signifies excellence, achievement, and the pursuit of knowledge as a noble endeavor.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic theological context, knowledge is seen as a means to draw closer to Allah (God). The name Alaamoon highlights the spiritual significance of knowledge and wisdom as a valuable gift bestowed upon individuals by Allah. It is a reminder that seeking knowledge is a lifelong journey that brings one closer to their Creator. By embodying the wisdom and knowledge of Allah, Alaamoon represents a servant who is striving to understand the divine will and live in accordance with it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Highly knowledgeable, wise" symbolizes One who is widely known, renowned for knowledge and wisdom. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Alaamoon serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of highly knowledgeable, wise.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Al-Alaamoon is mentioned in 'The Thousand Nights and One Night' as a jinni who possesses a magical tree.
